label: Collapse of a truth predicate: Collapse truth: for one predicate on one content type, ∀ p q, truth…
definition: `Collapse truth`: for one predicate on one content type, `∀ p q, truth p ↔ truth q`. The poles are `AllHold` and `AllFail`.
note: Stipulated test notion. The predicate and content type are parameters, so it covers a rival only once the rival's predicate is supplied.
